name: George Monbiot
bio: George Joshua Richard Monbiot is a British writer known for his environmental and political activism.

credits.title: Russell Brand: Open Secret
credits.overview: From comedy stardom to a criminal trial, inside voices and archive footage charts British comedian Russell Brand's meteoric rise and steep fall following allegations of sexual offences.

credits.title: Gaslit: The Truth About CO2 Gas Chambers in the UK
credits.overview: A look at practices in the UK chicken and pig farming industry.

credits.title: The Invisible Doctrine: The Secret History of Neoliberalism (& How It Came to Control Your Life)
credits.overview: George Monbiot deconstructs the roots, secretive propagation and deep impact of a doctrine that has played a profound role in transforming our economics, politics, environment, and how we've come to view ourselves.

credits.title: How to Save Democracy
credits.overview: With democracy in the U.S. crumbling, why is this happening and how do we save it? How to Save Democracy is an incisive and provocative film that explores the roots of democracy and its ebbs and flows over its history in the U.S., and why it is struggling to continue.

credits.title: I Could Never Go Vegan
credits.overview: 'I could never go vegan.' Five words uttered around the world by many a non-vegan, but why? On a quest for the truth, a filmmaker sets out on a journey to find out the leading arguments facing the vegan movement, and if they're justified.

credits.title: Rewilding a Nation
credits.overview: Robi Watkinson and Emma Hodson travel across Britain and the Netherlands documenting the story of the rewilding movement from its inception, to the return of the beaver, bison and perhaps one day, the lynx to Britain.

credits.title: Carne: The Unsustainable Footprint
credits.overview: It's a documentary about the consequences of our eating habits for the planet, our health and in animal well-being. Filmed in several countries: Portugal, Belgium, France, UK and Lebanon. It gives global insights about the problem.

credits.title: Seaspiracy
credits.overview: Passionate about ocean life, a filmmaker sets out to document the harm that humans do to marine species — and uncovers an alarming global conspiracy.

credits.title: The Cost of Living
credits.overview: THE COST OF LIVING is a documentary that explores the current socio-economic state of Britain and considers how the idea of a basic income could minimize poverty and the sociological toll of a growing precarious class. credits.title: How Wolves Change Rivers
credits.overview: When wolves were reintroduced to Yellowstone National Park in the United States after being absent nearly 70 years, the most remarkable "trophic cascade" occurred. What is a trophic cascade and how exactly do wolves change rivers? George Monbiot explains.

credits.title: The New Rulers of the World
credits.overview: The myths of globalisation have been incorporated into much of our everyday language. "Thinking globally" and "the global economy" are part of a jargon that assumes we are all part of one big global village, where national borders and national identities no longer matter.
